content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: Analytics(Mailbox Enumeration Activity by an Azure Application) AND Analytics(Microsoft 365 Storage Services Exfiltration Activity) observed on the same UserId / ClientIP within the run window — stitches app-driven mailbox harvest (MailItemsAccessed Bind burst across many mailboxes) followed by a bulk OneDrive/SharePoint download burst into a SINGLE Microsoft 365 collection-to-exfiltration incident. The shared identity (the mailbox owner UPN and the client IP the OAuth app operates from) is the pivot; the incident's terminal assertion is that one actor enumerated mailboxes AND pulled bulk storage in the same window, distinguishing a genuine data-theft chain from an isolated noisy download.
rules.name: Microsoft 365 App-Driven Mailbox Enumeration to Storage Exfiltration Stitch
